purpose: Usewords authors and inspects languages of expression. Encounter is one family with separate view and process dialects; language profiles explicitly select their meaning and execution route.

variants.name: Encounter views
variants.role: Representation, contextual contribution and inverse-edit language

variants.name: Encounter processes
variants.semantics: Existing lowering, admission and Temple kernel

variants.name: REL facts and contracts
variants.role: Identity, facts and closed type contracts

variants.name: Usewords construct definitions
variants.role: In-app declaration of text fields, required/maximum constraints, shared/local edit ownership and representations
variants.semantics: Closed REL contracts and Encounter views, checked by the retained compiler, type checker and ec.patch
variants.boundary: This first profile does not install arbitrary host code, add effect grants or define unrestricted computational semantics.

variants.name: Matter framing and AI suggestions
variants.role: Matter framing, lifecycle, participation, attention requests, relationships and scoped agent briefs
variants.grammar: Closed own-data records validated by mw.validate / mw.itemCheck / mw.checkSuggestions
variants.semantics: mw.add through ws.apply and collaborative proposal review/replay; representations through mw.paint
variants.boundary: Incorporating framing does not establish truth, consent, agreement or resolution. Agent labels are self-reported; BYO responses cannot invoke effects.
variants.partyWork: source/shared/party-work.encounter; explicit disclosure, separate personal statements and replayable packets; source/shared/party-work-ui.encounter; local custody in source/party-work-ui.encounter

extensionContract: Declare syntax/profile identity and canonical representation
Supply an admitted compiler or interpreter through process algebra
Declare effects separately from syntax eligibility
Preserve source correspondence and exact identities
Define representation and inverse-edit correspondence where supported
Provide semantic checks, refusal cases and bounded correspondence evidence
boundary: Additional variants require explicit implementation and qualification. Naming a variant does not install a compiler, infer semantic equivalence or grant effects.
